text.title: Agency Discovery Call Scorecard Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the versioned rubric and the scored calls it governs: four axes (fit, budget, urgency, decision_maker) with two-decimal weights summing to 1.0 and none above 0.5, anchors ordered low to high and written as observable facts (currency ranges, calendar windows, roles or confirmed sign-off, ICP criteria met), the 0-100 formula, a single threshold strictly inside the range with the binary advance rule, the weekly same-version retro, and per lead an anchor pick with an evidence note per axis, scored within 24 hours by someone on the call, with `decision_maker` defaulting to the lowest anchor when authority was not confirmed. Validator at scripts/validate-agency-discovery-call-scorecard.py enforces it, including the weight sum and the score recomputation.

required.field: every change to weights or anchors is a new version with its date and reason (r-versioned-weekly-calibration)

exactly the four named axes plus any extra the agency can justify; each with `weight` (two decimals, at most 0.5, all summing to 1.0) and `anchors[]` ordered lowest to highest, every anchor an observable fact for its axis (r-four-axes-fit-budget-urgency-decision-maker, r-weights-sum-to-one-no-dominant-axis, r-anchors-are-observable-facts)
one number strictly inside the range and the binary rule "score at or above advances; below is rejected or nurtured" (r-single-threshold-inside-range)

scored calls: `lead`, `call_date`, `scored_at` within 24 hours, `scorer_on_call: true`, `rubric_version` equal to the rubric's, `axis_scores[]` with an `anchor_index` and an `evidence` note per axis (`authority_confirmed` on `decision_maker`), `score` recomputed by the formula, `decision` matching the threshold (r-scored-within-24h-with-evidence, r-decision-maker-scored-on-verified-authority)

forbidden.pattern: an anchor label that is an adjective ("poor", "good", "excellent", "strong", "weak") or, on `budget`, carries no amount, on `urgency` no calendar window, on `decision_maker` no role or authority — adjective-anchors
weights that do not sum to 1.0 within 0.001, or any weight above 0.5 — weights-do-not-sum
a `decision_maker` score above the lowest anchor with `authority_confirmed: false` — self-declared-decision-maker
a threshold at 0 or 100, a second threshold, or a band — grey-band-threshold
`scored_at` more than 24 hours after `call_date`, `scorer_on_call: false`, or an empty `evidence` on any axis — late-scoring-without-evidence
a lead scored under a `rubric_version` other than the rubric's, or a retro with `same_version_only: false` — live-rubric-edited-in-place
a `score` that the formula does not reproduce from the anchor picks, or an `anchor_index` outside the axis's anchors — r-score-formula-0-100
`axes[]` missing any of fit, budget, urgency, decision_maker — r-four-axes-fit-budget-urgency-decision-maker

output-contract.example: { "rubric_version": "v3", "version_date": "2026-05-04", "version_reason": "budget anchors moved from 10k/30k to 15k/40k EUR after Q1 close data showed no closed deal under 15k", "axes": [ {"name": "fit", "weight": 0.3, "anchors": ["outside ICP: none of industry, size or service line match", "meets 1-2 of 3 ICP criteria", "meets all 3 ICP criteria and asks for our core service line"]}, {"name": "budget", "weight": 0.3, "anchors": ["no budget named or under 15k EUR per year", "15k-40k EUR per year stated on the call", "above 40k EUR per year stated on the call"]}, {"name": "urgency", "weight": 0.2, "anchors": ["no date; browsing", "start this quarter", "start this month or a named deadline within 30 days"]}, {"name": "decision_maker", "weight": 0.2, "anchors": ["authority not discussed, or an individual contributor", "manager who must get sign-off from a named person", "owner, partner or director who confirmed they approve the spend"]} ], "score_range": {"min": 0, "max": 100}, "formula": "sum(weight * anchor_index / (anchor_count - 1)) * 100", "decision_threshold": 60, "threshold_rule": "score at or above decision_threshold advances; below is rejected or nurtured", "retro": {"cadence": "weekly", "same_version_only": true, "compares": ["advance_rate", "close_rate_of_advanced"]}, "leads": [ { "lead": "Nordwind Logistics", "call_date": "2026-05-06T10:00:00Z", "scored_at": "2026-05-06T14:20:00Z", "scorer_on_call": true, "rubric_version": "v3", "axis_scores": [ {"axis": "fit", "anchor_index": 2, "evidence": "logistics SME, 120 staff, asked for paid search management: all three ICP criteria"}, {"axis": "budget", "anchor_index": 1, "evidence": "'we have around 2,500 a month for this' = 30k EUR per year"}, {"axis": "urgency", "anchor_index": 2, "evidence": "'peak season starts in June, we need campaigns live by 1 June'"}, {"axis": "decision_maker", "anchor_index": 1, "evidence": "marketing manager; 'I need to run the number past our CFO, Eva' - authority not confirmed on the call", "authority_confirmed": false} ], "score": 75, "decision": "advance" } ] }

{ "rubric_version": "v3", "version_date": "2026-05-04", "version_reason": "tweaked weights on Wednesday", "axes": [ {"name": "fit", "weight": 0.4, "anchors": ["poor", "good", "excellent"]}, {"name": "budget", "weight": 0.4, "anchors": ["small budget", "decent budget", "large budget"]}, {"name": "urgency", "weight": 0.2, "anchors": ["not urgent", "somewhat urgent", "very urgent"]}, {"name": "decision_maker", "weight": 0.2, "anchors": ["individual contributor", "manager who must get sign-off from a named person", "owner or director who confirmed they approve the spend"]} ], "score_range": {"min": 0, "max": 100}, "formula": "sum(weight * anchor_index / (anchor_count - 1)) * 100", "decision_threshold": 100, "threshold_rule": "score at or above decision_threshold advances; below is rejected or nurtured", "retro": {"cadence": "weekly", "same_version_only": false, "compares": ["advance_rate"]}, "leads": [ { "lead": "Nordwind Logistics", "call_date": "2026-05-06T10:00:00Z", "scored_at": "2026-05-09T17:00:00Z", "scorer_on_call": true, "rubric_version": "v2", "axis_scores": [ {"axis": "fit", "anchor_index": 2, "evidence": "seemed like a great fit overall"}, {"axis": "budget", "anchor_index": 2, "evidence": "they can probably afford us"}, {"axis": "urgency", "anchor_index": 1, "evidence": "sounded fairly keen to start"}, {"axis": "decision_maker", "anchor_index": 2, "evidence": "CRM title says Head of Marketing", "authority_confirmed": false} ], "score": 85, "decision": "advance" } ] }

list.item: `axes[]` contains fit, budget, urgency and decision_maker (r-four-axes-fit-budget-urgency-decision-maker).
Weights have at most two decimals, none above 0.5, and sum to 1.0 within 0.001 (r-weights-sum-to-one-no-dominant-axis).

Every anchor is a fact the caller can quote: amounts on budget, calendar windows on urgency, roles or confirmed sign-off on decision_maker, ICP criteria on fit; anchors are ordered lowest to highest (r-anchors-are-observable-facts).
`score_range` is 0-100, `formula` is written in the rubric, and every lead's `score` equals `sum(weight * anchor_index / (anchor_count - 1)) * 100` (r-score-formula-0-100).
`decision_threshold` is one number strictly inside the range and each lead's `decision` follows the binary rule (r-single-threshold-inside-range).
`decision_maker` is at the lowest anchor whenever `authority_confirmed` is false (r-decision-maker-scored-on-verified-authority).
Every lead is scored within 24 hours of `call_date` by someone on the call, with an evidence note on every axis (r-scored-within-24h-with-evidence).
Every lead carries the rubric's `rubric_version`; the retro is weekly, same-version only, and compares advance rate and close rate of advanced leads (r-versioned-weekly-calibration).
